card.name: Linking word before an exception clause
card.fires_on: The small linking word ("or", "unless", a comma) that comes right after a drug or condition list and starts an added exception or time window. Seen in MAOI warnings and in "wash hands unless" instructions.

modes.label: or within 2 weeks
modes.description: The word "or" after MAOIs or tricyclic antidepressants, introducing a washout time window.
modes.example: patients being treated with monoamine oxidase inhibitors or tricyclic antidepressants,<< or>> within 2 weeks of discontinuation of

modes.label: unless / is for
modes.description: A word that opens an exception to an application instruction, such as washing hands.
modes.example: Wash hands after application<< unless>> gel is applied to Kaposi sar

modes.label: comma in a list
modes.description: A comma between near-synonyms in a legal-style list.
modes.example: convey the impression that such use is approved<<,>> endorsed, or authorized by the Central Intelligence

card.writes: It leans against words that mean negation, such as "not", so the text continues without a negation.
card.plain: It marks the small word that introduces an exception or an added time window after a list of drugs.
